description: Update client or conversation metadata in one call: add or remove tags, create a note, update custom fields, or set a category. Tags, notes, and fields apply to the client. dialog_category applies to the dialog and requires dialog_id. A note becomes a system message in the client's current conversation timeline, visible to operators in the Teletype panel. If an operation fails, other changes may still have been applied. Check partial_errors before retrying. Requires confirm: true.

add_tags.description: Names of tags to add. Non-existent tags are listed in partial_errors.

additional_payload.description: Additional client data (JSON string or object, for example { source: 'website' }).

client.description: Name/phone/email/client_id. Optional if dialog_id identifies the client.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation of changes to client data or conversation.

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom fields: {'order_id': '1234', 'segment': 'B2B'}. Replaces existing values by key.

delete_note_id.description: ID of the client note to delete (obtained from lookup_client_profile).

dialog_category.description: Category name for the dialog (requires dialog_id).

dialog_id.description: Conversation ID. Required for dialog_category and can identify the client for other changes.

force_additional_payload.description: Overwrite the data available in the additional information array (true) instead of merging it (false).

note.description: The text of the new note. It appears in the client's current conversation timeline, visible to operators.

remove_tags.description: Names of tags to be deleted.

name: annotate_client_record
title: Annotate client record
